name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription:
BFR mornings: the band superset is two rounds instead of three, with 10-second rests between rounds (evenings keep three). About 40 minutes now.
Fixed: last night's calf-raise fix could stop a BFR morning from counting as a finished round.
Fixed: if the morning BFR got cut short after the calf raises, the evening round dropped the seated calf raise with nothing in its place. It now stays in.
Weight shifts and marching in place are now in the quick-one rotation too. Turn either off under Settings, Quick ones, if you want.
